origin.description: The fir data frame has 50 rows and 3 columns. The number of balsam-fir seedlings in each quadrant of a grid of 50 five foot square quadrants were counted. The grid consisted of 5 rows of 10 quadrants in each row.
origin.details: This data frame contains the following columns: count: The number of seedlings in the quadrant. row: The row number of the quadrant. col: The quadrant number within the row. Source: Davison, A.C. and Hinkley, D.V. (1997) Bootstrap Methods and Their Application. Cambridge University Press.
origin.value: A data frame with 50 rows and 3 columns: count, row, col.

translation.description: The fir data frame has 50 rows and 3 columns. The number of balsam-fir seedlings in each quadrant of a grid of 50 five foot square quadrants were counted. The grid consisted of 5 rows of 10 quadrants in each row.
translation.details: 50 rows and 3 columns, returned as the column names and a list of rows. count: The number of seedlings in the quadrant. row: The row number of the quadrant. col: The quadrant number within the row.
translation.value: The column names and a list of 50 rows. count is numeric. row and col are integers.

from boot.data_sets import fir
columns, rows = fir()
